legal._comment: Replace <github-owner> with the actual GitHub org/user before `devvit publish --public`. See documentation/CUT-LIST.md for the deploy checklist.

gemini.notes: Free-tier eligible. Function-calling parameter schemas are passed as shallow OpenAPI-3.0 shapes (Gemini does not support $ref / oneOf / additionalProperties); deep validation runs server-side via Zod after the response lands.

compiler.policyNote: OpenAI and Gemini are on Reddit's approved AI provider list (PR #96). Anthropic is not — see documentation/CUT-LIST.md hard lock #4.

tagline: Speak it. Sandbox it. Send it. Undo it.

marketing.shortPitch: Type a moderation rule in English. EDICT compiles it, tests it on your sub's last 30 days, runs it in shadow until it's safe, and gives you 30-day undo on everything it does.
